title: ZapConvert
name: zapconvert
description: Private file converter for PDFs, Office documents, images, spreadsheets, audio and video. 38 of its 52 tools run in the browser, so files never leave the device; Office and media conversions run in RAM-only companion containers. Source: https://github.com/zapconvert/zapconvert

env.name: WEB_PORT
env.label: Web UI port
env.description: Host port for the web interface.

env.name: LICENSE_KEY
env.label: Lifetime Pass key (optional)
env.description: Leave empty for the free Community edition. A Lifetime Pass key unlocks 1 GB server uploads and hides the footer credit.

env.name: MEDIA_WORKER_TOKEN
env.label: Media worker token (optional)
env.description: Shared secret between the web app and the media worker. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32

note: No setup needed. Open http://<your-host>:3000 (or the port you chose). Office and media conversions become available once the Gotenberg and media worker containers report healthy, which can take a minute or two on first start. Docs: github.com/zapconvert/zapconvert
